en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a square medieval stone tower ruin on a slope planted with small trees or vines. Several people stand on the flat roof behind a railing, with a flag flying from a pole. The image is printed in sepia tones with a large blank area at the bottom for writing. At the bottom in red script it reads "Eilenburg. Sorbenthum." and along the right edge in small vertical print appears the publisher information.
